name: junuban
description: Junubân (جنوبان) — Persian RTL e-commerce platform for authentic Southern Iranian products.

scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/worker
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/web && npm run lint -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/worker
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
